channel.title: BHub Network — Cyprus
channel.description: Latest Cyprus business stories from BHub Network.

item.title: Sustainability: Council and Parliament strike deal on simpler transparency rules for financial product
item.description: The EU has agreed on a revised SFDR framework, introducing three new product categories to simplify sustainability reporting and combat greenwashing.

item.title: Equipping Europeans for the age of AI: Council approves conclusions
item.description: The EU Council has approved a new framework to integrate AI literacy into education and professional training across all member states, including Cyprus.

item.title: Every child has the right to grow up in safety and to dream about their future, says Special Envoy on children of Ukraine
item.description: The Council of Europe's Special Envoy highlights the ongoing violations of Ukrainian children's rights, emphasizing international cooperation for protection, return, and reintegration amid the ongoing conflict.

item.title: Delivering a more consistent and risk-based approach to AML/CFT across Europe: Rikke-Louise Ørum Petersen speaks at AMLP Forum
item.description: AMLA Executive Rikke-Louise Ørum Petersen outlined the transition toward a unified European AML/CFT framework, emphasizing the Single Rulebook and upcoming direct supervision starting in 2028.

item.title: Binance hack laundering ramps up as $149 million in bitcoin mixed through coinjoins: Elliptic
item.description: Hackers have begun laundering $149 million in Bitcoin stolen from Binance in 2019 using privacy-enhancing CoinJoin mixers, according to blockchain analytics firm Elliptic.

item.title: Statement by Eurogroup President Kyriakos Pierrakakis on the nominations for the post of ECB executive board members
item.description: France and Germany have nominated Laurence Boone and Markus Brunnermeier to fill two upcoming vacancies on the European Central Bank’s Executive Board.

item.title: Global Emerging Markets Risk Database (GEMs)
item.description: The EIB and IFC have made the GEMs database, a 40-year repository of emerging market credit risk data, publicly accessible for investors.

item.title: At a glance 2026
item.description: The EIB Group has announced its 2026 strategic focus on clean energy, digitalization, and innovation, supported by updated operational codes and financial instruments.

item.title: EIB Group Climate Adaptation Plan Phase 2 – 2026-2030
item.description: The EIB Group doubles its climate adaptation funding to €30 billion for 2026-2030, specifically targeting SMEs and resilient infrastructure to mitigate growing climate risks.

item.title: Nicosia HUB-IN's Heritage Walks were a success
item.description: Nicosia's Heritage Walks successfully boosted engagement with the historic city center, revealing high demand for urban regeneration and soft mobility infrastructure.

item.title: Update Grant Scheme Guide for Strengthening Resilience and Adaptation of Communities to Climate Change
item.description: The Cyprus Energy Agency has updated the guide for the €2.9 million EU-funded climate resilience grant scheme as more local communities secure funding for adaptation projects.

item.title: Statement by the Minister of Finance on the affirmation of the credit rating of the Republic of Cyprus
item.description: Moody's has affirmed Cyprus's A3 investment-grade credit rating with a stable outlook, reflecting strong fiscal performance despite geopolitical instability and internal legislative risks.

item.title: Almost €24 billion mobilised and 614 projects awarded for their support to critical technologies in Europe, according to Commission report
item.description: The European Commission reported €24 billion mobilised for 614 critical technology projects under the STEP initiative to boost EU competitiveness in digital and green sectors.

item.title: AI Board holds its tenth meeting
item.description: The EU AI Board's tenth meeting focused on industrial AI strategy, AI Act implementation, and new governance procedures, including a move to an elected chairmanship.

item.title: Reminder for submission of applications for student benefits for the academic year 2025/2026 until 30 November for families of Greek students and for repatriated families of Cypriots
item.description: The Ministry of Finance reminds Greek and repatriated Cypriot families to apply for student benefits for the 2025/2026 academic year by November 30.

item.title: Extension of the Validity of Reduced Excise Duty Rates on Motor Fuels for the period from 1 December 2026 to 31 March 2027
item.description: The Cyprus government has extended reduced excise duty rates on motor fuels until March 31, 2027, to mitigate high energy costs for businesses and households.

item.title: Confirmation of the Republic of Cyprus's Credit Rating and Maintenance of Outlook by Moody’s Investors Service
item.description: Moody’s confirms Cyprus’s A3 rating with a stable outlook, citing fiscal resilience while warning of risks from labor reforms and infrastructure delays.

item.title: The CBC hosted a successful coin design workshop
item.description: The Central Bank of Cyprus hosted a professional workshop to train Cypriot artists in coin design, aiming to localize and diversify future numismatic production.

item.title: Foreign Direct Investment 2025
item.description: The Central Bank of Cyprus reports a 4.1% rise in inward FDI to €381.4 billion for 2025, with notable growth in Asian partnerships and non-SPE domestic investments.

item.title: Share of government debt held by resident financial corporations highest in Czechia and Sweden
item.description: Cyprus ranks among the EU leaders for government debt held by non-residents, highlighting a significant reliance on international investors for sovereign financing.

item.title: Children in the EU – check our new infographic for more
item.description: Eurostat has released a comprehensive new infographic detailing demographic and social statistics regarding children across the European Union, including Cyprus.

item.title: Are households with kids becoming less common in EU?
item.description: Eurostat data reveals a significant decline in EU households with children, with Cyprus experiencing one of the sharpest drops over the last decade.

item.title: AI, GovTech and HealthTech the key priorities for establishing Greece as a regional digital technology hub
item.description: Greece targets AI, GovTech, and HealthTech to become a regional digital hub, projecting €1.35 billion in FDI and 21,000 new tech jobs by 2033.

item.title: Piraeus named Greece’s Best Cash Management Bank at the Euromoney Transaction Banking Awards 2026
item.description: Piraeus Bank secures Euromoney's "Greece’s Best Cash Management Bank 2026" award, highlighting its technological leadership in digital liquidity and transaction banking solutions.

item.title: Slush 2026: RIF backs Cyprus’ largest delegation of 25 innovative companies
item.description: RIF: Cyprus at SLUSH 2026 with 25 innovative companies participating in the national delegation For the first time, 25 Cypriot companies took part in the international innovation event in Helsinki, marking the sixth consecutive RIF-supported mission and highlighting the growth and evolution of…

item.title: RIF: Cyprus at SLUSH 2026 with 25 innovative companies participating in the national delegation
item.description: Cyprus sent its largest-ever delegation of 25 innovative companies to SLUSH 2026 in Helsinki, signaling the rapid internationalization of the island's tech ecosystem.

item.title: Business Mission to Lisbon, 2-4 March 2027
item.description: Greek and Portuguese business organizations are hosting a high-level trade mission in Lisbon in March 2027 focusing on B2B meetings in energy, tech, and construction.

item.title: The Bank of Greece begins publishing quarterly data on the cost of consumer credit
item.description: The Bank of Greece is launching quarterly APR data publications for consumer credit, increasing regional transparency and setting a new benchmark for cross-border lending.

item.title: Balance of Payments: September 2026
item.description: The September 2026 current account deficit widened to €520.4 million, driven by rising goods imports despite a growing services surplus and improved tourism receipts.

item.title: EU and EIB back Medusa to strengthen Mediterranean digital links and connect Jordan’s research community
item.description: The EU and EIB are funding the extension of the Medusa submarine cable to Jordan, enhancing digital connectivity and research collaboration across the Mediterranean, including Cyprus.

item.title: EIB Group approves €14 billion in new financing with focus on EU energy autonomy
item.description: The EIB Group has approved a €14 billion financing package, with a significant portion earmarked for upgrading Cyprus's electricity grid and supporting EU energy autonomy.

item.title: EIB Group approves €14 billion in new financing with focus on EU energy autonomy
item.description: The EIB Group has approved a €14 billion financing package, including specific funding to modernize and reinforce Cyprus's electricity grid to support energy autonomy.

item.title: ADDITIONAL ANNOUNCEMENT - Distribution of non-mandatory reserves
item.description: Eurobank finalizes its interim dividend at €0.05991 per share following an adjustment for treasury shares, with distribution set for late 2024.

item.title: Temporary Suspension of DAC2/CRS File Submission Service
item.description: Cyprus Tax Department will suspend DAC2/CRS submissions from Dec 14, 2026, to Jan 17, 2027, to transition to the new XSD Schema v3.0 reporting standard.

item.title: Opening Keynote speech by the Chief Scientist for Research, Innovation and Technology of the Republic of Cyprus, Mr Demetris Skourides, at the 5th CSN Greece ICT Conference 2026
item.description: Cyprus' Chief Scientist outlines a strategy for AI integration in shipping, emphasizing reliability, human oversight, and the transition from data collection to predictive foresight.

item.title: Address by the Minister of Energy, Commerce and Industry, Mr Michael Damianos, at the Gala Dinner for the European Golf Association AGM
item.description: Cyprus intensifies its focus on golf tourism to combat seasonality and reach a target of 40% off-peak overnight stays by 2035.

item.title: Hotel Upgrades, International Brands and Branded Residences on the Investment Agenda of R&R 2026
item.description: Greece is intensifying its focus on luxury hotel upgrades, international brand expansion, and branded residences, signaling a regional trend that directly competes with Cyprus's tourism investment model.

item.title: Strong Greek presence at EquipHotel
item.description: Greek hospitality suppliers demonstrated high-value innovation at EquipHotel Paris 2026, signaling new partnership opportunities for regional hotel chains and technology integrators.

item.title: “Greece in Orbit”: Record Greek participation in Space Tech Expo Europe 2026 and first joint presence wit…
item.description: Greece and Cyprus established a unified 'Greece in Orbit' presence at Space Tech Expo Europe 2026, marking a record participation for the Hellenic space ecosystem.

item.title: Twelve Greek companies and organizations seek a role in the reconstruction of Ukraine
item.description: Twelve major Greek companies, spanning energy, construction, and technology, participated in the ReBuild Ukraine 2026 expo to secure a role in the country's multi-billion dollar reconstruction efforts.

item.title: Establishment of Cyprus-Palestine Business Association
item.description: The Cyprus Chamber of Commerce and Industry (CCCI) is seeking expressions of interest to form a Cyprus–Palestine Business Association to boost bilateral trade and investment.

item.title: Free Technical Support to PWDs to Apply for a Sponsorship for Photovoltaics
item.description: The Cyprus Energy Agency is offering free technical support to Persons with Disabilities to facilitate applications for photovoltaic system grants and energy efficiency upgrades.

item.title: Resignation (Charalambos Tsioupis)
item.description: Energy Engineer Charalambos Tsioupis has resigned from the Cyprus Energy Regulatory Authority (CERA), effective November 16, 2026.

item.title: Launch of the national digital financial literacy portal "moneypedia.cy"
item.description: Cyprus launches 'moneypedia.cy', a central digital portal dedicated to enhancing financial literacy and providing tools for informed economic decision-making.

item.title: Reaching Up for Faster Growth
item.description: Global growth is increasingly driven by AI and trade, but rising inflation and public debt necessitate cautious fiscal policies and urgent digital structural reforms for Cyprus businesses.

item.title: Price Index of Construction Materials - Annual Change +4,09% (Oct 2026)
item.description: The Price Index of Construction Materials in Cyprus rose by 4.09% year-on-year in October 2026, signaling continued upward pressure on building costs.

item.title: Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices - Annual Rate of Change 5,4% (Oct 2026)
item.description: Cyprus' Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices rose by 5.4% in October 2026, signaling persistent inflationary pressures across the local economy.

item.title: Address by the Deputy Minister of Research, Innovation and Digital Policy at the Cyprus Institute of Neurology and Genetics Graduation
item.description: The Deputy Minister of Research addressed 70 new CING graduates, emphasizing the role of resilience in scientific innovation and the Institute's impact on Cyprus's biomedical sector.

item.title: Deputy Minister of Migration, Research Deputy Minister – Press Conference
item.description: The Cyprus government announces the digitisation of Migration Department services to improve efficiency and support the national digital transformation strategy.

item.title: Statement by Executive Vice-President Mînzatu and Commissioner Lahbib ahead of European Equal Pay Day
item.description: The EU marks Equal Pay Day, emphasizing the June 2026 deadline for Cyprus and other member states to transpose the Pay Transparency Directive into national law.
